{{Quote|To be a Vigo in Black Sun is to enjoy more power than all but a handful of beings in the entire galaxy.|Prince Xizor|<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''Vigo''' was a title used by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate to denote the organization's leadership. It meant "nephew" in [[Tionese/Legends|Old Tionese]].

At any given time, nine of these [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] each oversaw a different region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and reported directly to the organization's head, the Black Sun [[Underlord]].

==Overview==
{{quote|To be a Vigo in Black Sun is to enjoy more power than all but a handful of beings in the entire galaxy.|Xizor's reminder to his lieutenants.|<ref name="SB" />}}
The word ''Vigo'' meant "nephew" in [[Tionese/Legends|Old Tionese]], which created the semblance of a familial bond between the leadership, making them appear stronger and indivisible to outsiders.<ref name="SOTE" /> 

Vigos only numbered nine and were assigned to oversee the organization's operations in one of nine sectors of the galaxy; the Vigos had a loose alliance with each other and reported directly to Black Sun's leader.<ref name="SB" /><ref name="DM1">[[Darth Maul (2000) 1|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 1]]</ref> Selected from the ranks of Black Sun's membership, the Vigos either climbed the Black Sun's criminal hierarchy (sometime beginning as petty criminals, and eventually a former Vigo's sublieutenants) or inherited the position from their parents. They received a vast salary, generous awards and bonuses, and were not above skimming some of Black Sun's profits, thus creating an incredible wealth.<ref name="SB" />

Each Vigo had several [[sublieutenant/Legends|sub-lieutenants]], advisors and lackeys under them, with whom they ruled a vast criminal Empire, supported by Black Sun's funds; these underlings usually hoped, and made plans, to inherit place of their Vigo in the future. Each Vigo had their own [[Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] network, talents, strengths, m.o. and practices. The networks were so vast, that, unwittingly, some underlings belonged simultaneously to more than one, causing some conflicts. Some were spying on their Vigos, reporting their activities directly to the Black Sun Underlord himself, although few Vigos dared to betray their master.<ref name="SB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Many Vigos had their own transport networks of [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[free-trader]]s to deliver equipment, personnel and contraband. During Xizor's rule, some mainly used the fleet of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]].<ref name="SB" />

==History==
Since the [[Kian'thar]]s joined the [[Galactic community]] around [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], one joined the Vigos of Black Sun, displaying the [[species/Legends|species]]'s empathic abilities; since then, there had always been at least a Kian'thar Vigo, sometimes hereditary.<ref name="SB" />

[[File:BlackSunVigo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Zabrak Black Sun vigo]]
Under the leadership of Underlord [[Alexi Garyn]], Black Sun and the nine Vigos built a reign of fear felt on every planet from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the decade preceding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This surge in power drew the attention of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. To rectify this, the Sith dispatched their [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], to [[Mission to Ralltiir|assassinate]] the Vigos and Garyn at their [[Black Sun Fortress|fortress]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Catching the Vigos off their guard, Maul wiped out the leaders and Black Sun fell into disarray for years.<ref name="DM4">[[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 4]]</ref>

Despite the purge, Black Sun recovered and a new generation of Vigos was appointed from the remnants of the organization. By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the Vigos were attempting to rebuild, though they faced many challenges. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] took out a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Vigo [[Antonin]] during this time, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the lieutenant on behalf of a contract with [[Dreddon]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jango Fett one-shot">[[Star Wars: Jango Fett (one-shot)|''Star Wars: Jango Fett'']]</ref> Vigo [[Cash Garrulan]] retired from Black Sun during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], remaining a powerful crime lord on [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] and forming a respectful relationship with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Roan Shryne]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

While the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Vigo [[Xist]] managed to retain his holdings on [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]] during the war,<ref name="Obsession 1">[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]]</ref> Vigo [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was betrayed by his [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] lover [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] on the Hutt world [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Despite the setbacks, Black Sun came to great power once more under the leadership of Underlord [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], Prince Xizor ordered his assassin [[Guri]] to execute Vigo [[Green]] after Green's betrayal.<ref name="SOTE" />

During the Rebellion, Han Solo was contracted by Eanjer, a businessman whose family had been killed by Black Sun, to break into Black Sun governor [[Avrak Villachor]]'s vault on [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] and retrieve his money. Solo assembled a team of outlaws he knew, which also included Leia's aide, Winter. A Falleen vigo named [[Qazadi]] was also present at the time, making the operation more difficult, but they successfully broke into the mansion and emptied the vault, which contained an Alderaanian encryption device known as a [[cryodex]] and a copy of the Black Sun's blackmail database. At the end of the raid, Eanjer assassinated Qazadi, revealing himself to be [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in disguise.<ref name="scoundrel">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
